verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only a generic org token passed to the SDK and org-level agent permission toggles, such as allowing PR creation or requiring signed commits. Those toggles are adjacent behavioral controls, not a way to issue scoped or least-privilege API credentials. Nothing documents creating API keys with restricted scopes, per-agent credentials, or expiry.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
